actors.name: Bạch Chỉ
actors.description: An adult woman herbalist about thirty. Warm tea-leaf green and ivory clothes; practical sleeves tied snugly. A compact herb basket and a small jade pestle visibly identify her profession. Soft-spoken but observant and discerning expression. Adult face, no child face. Hair is simply bound for work with no added ornament; the authored brief does not specify a hair arrangement.
actors.poseBrief: Relaxed standing neutral, the small herb basket held beside the lower waist and the small jade pestle resting in the other hand below the chest. Both hands and profession props remain readable without obscuring the face or boots.

authoredBrief.name: Bạch Chỉ
authoredBrief.look: Nữ khoảng ba mươi; áo lá trà/ngà, tay áo buộc gọn, giỏ dược và chày ngọc.
authoredBrief.personality: Mềm lời nhưng không dễ tin; kể chuyện qua mùi và vết cắt lá.

authoredBrief.quote: Lá còn tươi chưa chắc khí còn nguyên. Hái dược cũng phải biết chờ.
authoredBrief.react: Sau EX01 nhắc đúng loại mẫu đã kiểm; đầy HP không tiêu vật tư chỉ để tạo hiệu ứng.
authoredBrief.brief: Silhouette giỏ dược, bàn tay chày; palette lá ấm khác áo ngọc của giảng sư.

actors.name: Tống Thiết
actors.description: An elderly male artificer with short silver-white hair and a direct practical expression. Ash-brown work apron and copper-toned shoulder cloth. A compact pair of tongs and an unfinished wooden-sword blank. A sturdy worker body while preserving the large chibi head, short torso and legs of the live Wang human contract. No large muscles or tall realistic anatomy.
actors.poseBrief: Relaxed planted standing neutral, small tongs and unfinished wooden-sword blank held below the chest. The blank stays compact, close to the body and leg silhouette; neither tool crosses the face.

authoredBrief.name: Tống Thiết
authoredBrief.look: Nam lớn tuổi; tóc bạc ngắn, tạp dề nâu tro, vai áo đồng, kìm và phôi mộc kiếm.
authoredBrief.personality: Thẳng tính; quý người sửa được vật hơn người nói giỏi.

actors.name: Hứa Hành
actors.description: An adult male route keeper, practical and quietly tired. Short dusty-grey cloak patched asymmetrically on one side. Compact map tube, old sealing cord and muddy boots, with a small route-paper detail. Plain compact hair with no added decorative gear; the authored brief does not specify hair. His silhouette reads as a weary field route keeper, not an armored guard.
actors.poseBrief: Relaxed planted standing neutral with the short cloak hanging clearly and map tube close to the hip. A compact folded route paper rests low near one hand, held below the chest, keeping face and boots clear.

authoredBrief.personality: Thực tế; giấu sự mệt mỏi hơn là giấu động cơ.

actors.name: Đinh Sóc
actors.description: A young adult male gate disciple. Dark blue-green robe, light copper shoulder armor that marks his duty, a small slim long spear and a route tag hanging at the hip. Firm disciplined but approachable expression. Plain compact hair without added decoration; the authored brief does not specify hair. Keep the young-adult identity distinct from an elderly instructor.
actors.poseBrief: The slim small spear lies diagonally low beside the lower body with the tip pointing DOWN, held below the chest. Keep the entire compact shaft and tip between crown and boot height; no weapon pixel above the crown or below the soles. The standing world foot is measured from the boot soles, never from the spear tip. The copper shoulder duty mark and hip route tag remain readable.

authoredBrief.look: Nam trẻ; áo xanh sẫm, giáp vai đồng nhẹ, trường thương nhỏ, thẻ tuyến treo hông.
authoredBrief.personality: Cứng ở luật, mềm ở lời; nhớ người vừa thất bại ngoài tuyến.

actors.description: An adult female cultivation disciple. Light pale-blue robe, short tied hair, a compact water gourd and a partially studied bamboo slip booklet.
